Explicit use of Alekseyev's already proved matching criterion is disclosed.

value.rationale: For the natural fixed-n robustness question left after characterizing existence and universality, the exact probability among all primitive start/step pairs is a previously unstated complete invariant. It resolves the local saturation thresholds for every prime-power exponent, orders robustness under divisibility, distinguishes n=4 from n=8 and 27 from 243, and explains why even nonmatchable n have a positive proportion of matchable progressions while the global infimum is zero. This is a motivated exact natural invariant, not an arbitrary finite computation.
